name: Run Model Tests
description: Executes the model capability test suite against a specified model. Returns structured test results compatible with the Knowledge Base.

inputs.name: Test Categories
inputs.description: Comma-separated list of categories to test (outputFormat, instructionFollowing, contextMemory, reasoning, toolCalling, codeGeneration) or 'all'

inputs.name: LLM Provider URL
inputs.description: URL of the LLM Provider API

outputs.name: Test Results
outputs.description: Complete test results following model-test-result schema

outputs.name: Summary
outputs.description: Quick summary with score, classification, pass/fail counts

metadata.author: Maestro Team
metadata.overrideInstructions: Clone this block to customize test execution parameters or add pre/post processing steps.
